generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

itemList.description: Barricading of Standard Specifications on Vijaya Dashami Day to Procession Route with Casirona Pole Support as 2.5 Mtr c/c. The work to start 5 days before Vijaya Dashami Day to complete the work sucessfully including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, lead and lift charges, and clearing the site for the next event, etc., complete as per specification as directed by the officer in charge of the work.

Providing and erecting on hire basis Mojo Barricading of 5ft Height Standard Specifications on Vijaya Dashami Day to Procession Route at Chamaraja circle, City Bus stand Entrance, KR Circle, Old Bank Road, Bata Junction, KR Hospital Road & Ayurveda Circle with Casirona Pole Support at 2.5 Mtrs c/c including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, lead and lift charges and cleaning the site for the next event etc. complete as per specification as directed by the officer in charge of the woRK

Providing Erecting & Removing Casurona Pole Barricading (Cloth Covering) with Weld Mesh Covering upto 5ft Height using poles of 7.5 to 10cms dia and 1.5 height above ground fixing vertically at interval of 2.0 to 2.5 mtrs c/c and horizontally at 0.5 mtr, above ground level, including fixing poles in the ground level for minimum depth of 0.30 mtr and tied with coir rope firmly including cost and conveyance of all the materials labour lead and lift and as per direction of Engineer in charge work

Providing Erecting & Removing Casurinapole Barricading with Cloth using poles of 7.5 to 10 cms dia and 1.2 height above ground fixing vertically at interval of 2.0 to 2.5 mtrs c/c and horizontally at 0.5 mtr, above ground level, including fixing poles in the ground level for minimum depth of 0.30 mtr and tied with coir rope firmly including cost and conveyance of all the materials labour lead and lift charges and clearing the site for the next event etc, complete as per specification as directed by the officer in charge of the work

Providing & Erecting on the hire basis Good Quality Mojo Barricading of standard specification inclusive of cost of all transportation labour, clearing the site for the next event etc., complete as per specification 2as directed by the Officer in charge of the work with all the lead and lift as as per the direction of Engineer in Charge of Work.For 14 days Opposite to Mysuru Palace
